title: Man Standing in Doorway, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot showing a middle-aged man standing in the open doorway of a house. He is dressed in high-waisted trousers with a shiny belt buckle and a collared button-up shirt. The house has a white painted or stucco exterior with small potted plants arranged on the concrete step. The photo features decorative scalloped/deckled edges typical of mid-20th century prints.
